claims_boundary: Bitcoin post-quantum work now includes a consensus-compatible mainnet proof-of-concept (QSB) plus protocol-level research on SHRINCS, DropKick, and BIP-361. These are different maturity planes. QSB does not make Bitcoin quantum-safe, and draft protocol work is not consensus-active.

current_assessment.qsb: Demonstrates an opt-in prepositioning path on Bitcoin mainnet using existing consensus rules, but requires nonstandard handling and does not cover already-exposed keys or network-wide migration.
current_assessment.protocol_stack: SHRINCS + DropKick + BIP-361 remain a dependency-complete research stack, not deployed protocol protection.
current_assessment.proof_maturity: libshrincs materially improves implementation-assurance evidence for the WOTS+C component, but it is explicitly a proof-of-concept component toward full SHRINCS and must not be reported as a complete proof of the full signature scheme.
current_assessment.priority: Integrate QSB into contingency planning while accelerating protocol-level PQ authorization, independent review, wallet interoperability, relay policy, rescue, and sunset engineering.
